tvShow.name: Lord of Mysteries
tvShow.overview: In a Victorian world of steam, dreadnoughts, and occult horrors, Zhou Mingrui awakens as Klein Moretti. He walks a razor’s edge between light and darkness, entangled with warring Churches. This is the legend of unlimited potential…and unspeakable danger.

episodes.name: Old Neil's Mysticism Class - Lesson 1
episodes.overview: Mysticism class on the geographical distribution of the Northern Continent and the world's languages.

episodes.name: Lord of Mysteries Chibi - 01 - Zhou Mingrui's Unlucky Day
episodes.overview: Life is tough when you're Zhou Mingrui.

episodes.name: Old Neil's Mysticism Class - Lesson 2
episodes.overview: Mysticism class on Beyonder pathways, the Nighthawks, and Spirit vision.

episodes.name: Lord of Mysteries Chibi - 02 - Buying a Cane
episodes.overview: Buying a cane is serious business.

episodes.name: Old Neil's Mysticism Class - Lesson 3
episodes.overview: Mysticism class on the Seer, Corpse Collector, and Sleepless pathways, from Sequence 9 to Sequence 7.

episodes.name: Lord of Mysteries Chibi - 03 - Ending the Lease
episodes.overview: Ending a lease early isn't easy, but Klein Moretti's got a trick up his sleeve.

episodes.name: Old Neil's Mysticism Class - Lesson 4
episodes.overview: Mysticism class on ritualistic magic, honorific names, and basic knowledge about the Mystery Pryer pathway.

episodes.name: Lord of Mysteries Chibi - 04 - The Divination Club
episodes.overview: Klein Moretti proves that he's the real deal to the Divination Club.

episodes.name: Old Neil's Mysticism Class - Lesson 5
episodes.overview: Mysticism class on the Assassin pathway and the monetary system of the Loen Kingdom.

episodes.name: Lord of Mysteries Chibi - 05 - Old Neil's Opportunistic Strategies
episodes.overview: Old Neil teaches Klein how to take advantage of reimbursements.

episodes.name: Old Neil's Mysticism Class - Lesson 6
episodes.overview: Mysticism class on orthodox organizations, hidden organizations, and taboos.

episodes.name: Lord of Mysteries Chibi - 06 - The Cute Newcomer and the Old Veteran
episodes.overview: Klein works with Leonard on a mission.

episodes.name: Old Neil's Mysticism Class - Lesson 7
episodes.overview: Neil explains the different uses of spiritualism through different Sequences.

episodes.name: Lord of Mysteries Chibi - 07 - The Tale of the 1,000 Pounds
episodes.overview: Alger quickly needs a large sum of money.

episodes.name: Old Neil's Mysticism Class - Lesson 8
episodes.overview: Introduction to the ways of losing control after consuming potions and the Forsaken Land of the Gods.

episodes.name: Lord of Mysteries Chibi - 08 - The Mr. Fool in My Heart
episodes.overview: The Tarot Club talks about Mr. Fool.

episodes.name: Lord of Mysteries Chibi - 09 - Klein's Nightmare
episodes.overview: Dunn has taken the role of Nightmare too literally.

episodes.name: Lord of Mysteries Special: City of Silver
episodes.overview: A young man from a place without sunlight prays to the Fool and discovers the Tarot Club.

episodes.name: The Marked Hunt (1)
episodes.overview: Alger Wilson discovers his lifelong friend is after his life and moves to make a preemptive strike.

episodes.name: The Marked Hunt (2)
episodes.overview: Audrey Hall attends a social ball and discovers a great danger lurking behind a disguise.

episodes.name: The Fool
episodes.overview: Zhou Mingrui wakes up in the body of Klein Moretti. A strange notebook holds the key to a dark power.

episodes.name: Beyonder
episodes.overview: Klein Moretti joins the Nighthawks and heads off on his first task to find an abducted child.

episodes.name: The Notebook
episodes.overview: Klein Moretti pursues the Antigonus Family's notebook and faces off against another Beyonder.

episodes.name: Magic Mirror
episodes.overview: Klein Moretti learns ritualistic magic from Old Neil. Meanwhile, an organization has their eyes on Klein.

episodes.name: Hero
episodes.overview: A tragedy befalls a passenger ship and Klein Moretti is tasked with solving the mystery.

episodes.name: Teacher
episodes.overview: Klein Moretti discovers an ancient secret about his teacher, Azik Eggers.

episodes.name: Coincidence
episodes.overview: When too many coincidences appear, Klein Moretti discovers he may be caught in an elaborate scheme.

episodes.name: Losing Control
episodes.overview: Klein Moretti is on a mission, and the most dreaded fate that could happen to a Beyonder becomes reality.

episodes.name: Party
episodes.overview: Klein succeeds in ascending to Sequence 8, but this glorious moment is overshadowed by an event.

episodes.name: Clue
episodes.overview: Dunn and Klein attend the scene of a possibly supernatural murder of a congressman.

episodes.name: Mastermind
episodes.overview: Following Klein's suspicions, the Nighthawk investigates what Sharon Khoy is hiding.

episodes.name: The Bomb
episodes.overview: Lanevus threatens to destroy Tingen, putting the Nighthawks in check.

episodes.name: Light
episodes.overview: The Nighthawks defend Tingen from evil's descent, and past events are revealed to be more than coincidences.
